'''''Bougainvillea'' × ''buttiana''''' is a [[flowering plant]], a garden hybrid of ''[[Bougainvillea glabra]]'' and ''[[Bougainvillea peruviana]]''.<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.ars-grin.gov/cgi-bin/npgs/html/splist.pl?1617# |title=Germplasm Resources Information Network. United States Department of Agriculture |access-date=2014-05-14 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090120104812/http://www.ars-grin.gov/cgi-bin/npgs/html/splist.pl?1617# |archive-date=2009-01-20 |url-status=dead }}</ref>
[[File:Nyctaginaceae - Bougainvillea buttiana.JPG|thumb|Flower surrounded by bracts]]

Growing to {{convert|5|m|ft}} tall by {{convert|1.5|m|ft}} broad, It is an [[evergreen]] [[vine]], with thorny [[Plant stem|stems]] and tiny trumpet shaped white [[flower]]s, usually appearing in clusters surrounded by three showy bright magenta-rose papery [[bract]]s. The [[Leaf|leaves]] are ovate and dark green.

This plant can be grown in a warm temperate or subtropical environment where the temperature does not fall below freezing ({{convert|0|C|F}}), against a south-facing wall in full sun. Numerous cultivars have been developed, of which the following have gained the [[Royal Horticultural Society]]'s [[Award of Garden Merit]]:
*'Miss Manila'<ref>{{cite web 
| url= https://www.rhs.org.uk/Plants/49153/i-Bougainvillea-i-×-i-buttiana-i-Miss-Manila/Details
| title = RHS Plantfinder - ''Bougainvillea'' × ''buttiana'' 'Miss Manila'
| accessdate=12 January 2018}}</ref> 
*'Mrs Butt'<ref>{{cite web 
| url= https://www.rhs.org.uk/Plants/45517/i-Bougainvillea-i-×-i-buttiana-i-Mrs-Butt/Details
| title = RHS Plantfinder - ''Bougainvillea'' × ''buttiana'' ''Mrs Butt''
| accessdate=12 January 2018}}</ref>
*'Poulton's Special'<ref>{{cite web 
| url= https://www.rhs.org.uk/Plants/2359/i-Bougainvillea-i-×-i-buttiana-i-Poulton-s-Special/Details
| title = RHS Plantfinder - ''Bougainvillea'' × ''buttiana'' 'Poulton's Special'
| accessdate=12 January 2018}}</ref>
